conditions: A and B events on the same probability space, P(B)>0.
spoken_aliases: the probability of a given b equals the probability of the intersection of a and b divided by the probability of b
probability of a given b equals the fraction with numerator the probability that both a and b occur and denominator the probability of b

evidence: Restrict the probability measure to B and renormalize by its positive mass P(B). The mass of A in this restricted probability space is the mass of A intersection B divided by P(B). This is the definition for conditioning on an event of positive probability.
Reference cross-check: https://openstax.org/books/principles-data-science/pages/3-4-probability-theory. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
